description: Paper networks (held-out-speed models): trained on the two 60 s speed ramps (S1 and S2) with the 4.5 and 5.5 km/h steps, plus 5 s on either side, removed from the training set (42,795 samples at 110 Hz). Seed 0. PyTorch state_dicts, load with torch.load(..., weights_only=True).

architecture.type: causal dilated TCN (Bai et al. 2018): GroupNorm(1, 3) input, 7 causal conv layers with BatchNorm, ReLU, dropout, identity skip in layers 2-7, linear heads on the last time step
architecture.input_signal: causal bandpass (0.5-15 Hz) ferroelectret signal in volts, 330 Hz downsampled by 3 (every third sample)

heads.head_add: [sin, cos] additive correction to the C-AO phase

training.loss: L_abs + L_add + 0.5 L_conf (squared sin/cos errors per valid sample; confidence target 1/(1+|dphi|))
training.optimizer: Adam, lr 3e-3, weight decay 1e-5, gradient clipping at norm 1
training.augmentation: per-channel amplitude scaling U[0.05, 5], 10 % channel dropout, Gaussian noise sigma 0.01
training.checkpoint: epoch with the lowest training loss
